result.instructions: Tools for Placetel, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which calls did we miss today, and who called?"; "Show the call detail records for yesterday."; "Which of our phone numbers use which routing, and who is in the sales ring group?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Placetel data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run placetel_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run placetel_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run placetel_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. placetel_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: placetel_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The Placetel account this API key belongs to: user id, name, email, company, platform (e.g. PROFI), primary SIP user id and the numbers the key may use. GET /me.

tools.name: placetel_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the web users of the account (main account and sub-users) with name, email, login, type, permissions and numbers. Filter by name, email, login or type. GET /users.

type.description: Only the main account or only sub-users.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1-100 (default 25). Not every endpoint honours it; keep paging until a page is empty.

tools.name: placetel_list_sip_users
tools.title: List SIP users (extensions)
tools.description: List SIP users (phone extensions, softphones, fax and trunk lines) with extension number (did), caller id, type, online state and registrations. SIP passwords and PINs are never returned. GET /sip_users.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1-100 (default 25). Not every endpoint honours it; keep paging until a page is empty.

tools.name: placetel_get_sip_user
tools.title: Get SIP user
tools.description: One SIP user (extension) by id: sipuid, extension, caller id, type, linked web user, online state and call settings. The SIP password and PINs are never returned. GET /sip_users/{id}.

tools.name: placetel_list_calls
tools.title: List incoming calls
tools.description: Incoming calls (accepted, missed, blocked, voicemail) on one day, today by default: caller number, called number, duration, matching contact, voicemail file URL and unread flag. For a different day pass date. GET /calls.

from_number.description: Only calls from this caller number.

to_number.description: Only calls to this of your numbers.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1-100 (default 25). Not every endpoint honours it; keep paging until a page is empty.

tools.name: placetel_get_call
tools.title: Get call
tools.description: One incoming call by id: caller, called number, type, duration, contact, voicemail file URL. GET /calls/{id}.

tools.name: placetel_list_call_detail_records
tools.title: List call detail records
tools.description: Call detail records (billing view) for one day: from, to, answering SIP user, length in seconds, cost amount and description. date is required. GET /call_detail_records.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1-100 (default 25). Not every endpoint honours it; keep paging until a page is empty.

tools.name: placetel_list_recordings
tools.title: List call recordings
tools.description: Call recordings with direction, from, to, duration, time and the file URL. Filter by direction, number or day. GET /recordings.

date.description: Only recordings of this day, yyyy-mm-dd.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1-100 (default 25). Not every endpoint honours it; keep paging until a page is empty.

tools.name: placetel_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List the shared phone-book contacts with names, company, phone/mobile/fax numbers, emails, tags and blocked flag. Filter by name, company, email, number or update time. search_number finds a contact by any of its numbers. GET /contacts.

blocked.description: Only blocked (true) or only non-blocked (false) contacts.

updated_since.description: Only contacts updated at or after this date/time.

updated_until.description: Only contacts updated at or before this date/time.

search_number.description: Find the contact that owns this phone number (any of its number fields).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1-100 (default 25). Not every endpoint honours it; keep paging until a page is empty.

tools.name: placetel_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: One contact by id with all its fields. GET /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: placetel_list_numbers
tools.title: List phone numbers
tools.description: List the phone numbers of the account with number, E.164 form, name, description, site, activation state and the routing object id that answers them. GET /numbers.

activated.description: Only activated (true) or deactivated (false) numbers (Profi plans).

site_id.description: Only numbers of this site (see placetel_list_sites).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1-100 (default 25). Not every endpoint honours it; keep paging until a page is empty.

tools.name: placetel_get_number
tools.title: Get phone number
tools.description: One phone number by id: number, E.164, name, site, carrier, activation state and routing id. GET /numbers/{id}.

tools.name: placetel_list_number_profiles
tools.title: List number profiles
tools.description: The routing profiles of a phone number (for example Standard, Holiday, Night) and which one is active. Needs a Placetel plan with number profiles. GET /numbers/{number_id}/profiles.

tools.name: placetel_list_routings
tools.title: List routings
tools.description: List routing objects (what happens to an incoming call: forward, group, routing plan, IVR, queue, voicemail, API) with their settings and time settings. Filter by update time. GET /routings.

updated_since.description: Only routings updated at or after this date/time.

updated_until.description: Only routings updated at or before this date/time.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1-100 (default 25). Not every endpoint honours it; keep paging until a page is empty.

tools.name: placetel_get_routing
tools.title: Get routing
tools.description: One routing object by its id or by the phone number it answers. GET /routings/{number_or_id}.

number_or_id.description: A routing id (e.g. 4711) or a phone number (e.g. 022112345678).

tools.name: placetel_list_routing_plans
tools.title: List routing plans
tools.description: List routing plans (time-based call distribution plans) with name, description, ring duration and object counts. GET /routing_plans.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1-100 (default 25). Not every endpoint honours it; keep paging until a page is empty.

tools.name: placetel_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List ring groups (ring_all, hunt, monitoring) with members. Filter by name, description or type. GET /groups.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1-100 (default 25). Not every endpoint honours it; keep paging until a page is empty.

tools.name: placetel_list_sites
tools.title: List sites
tools.description: List company sites (locations) with address and prefix. GET /sites.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1-100 (default 25). Not every endpoint honours it; keep paging until a page is empty.

tools.name: placetel_list_faxes
tools.title: List faxes
tools.description: In- and outbound faxes with from/to number, status, pages, duration, type and the file URL. Filter by direction or number. GET /faxes.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1-100 (default 25). Not every endpoint honours it; keep paging until a page is empty.

tools.name: placetel_get_fax
tools.title: Get fax
tools.description: One fax by id: numbers, status, status info, pages, retries, report and file URL. GET /faxes/{id}.

tools.name: placetel_list_call_center_queues
tools.title: List call center queues
tools.description: List call-center queues with name, ring time, loops and prompts. Use the ids to filter call-center calls. GET /call_center_queues.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1-100 (default 25). Not every endpoint honours it; keep paging until a page is empty.

tools.name: placetel_list_call_center_agents
tools.title: List call center agents
tools.description: List call-center agents with name, status, extension, priority and last call time. GET /call_center_agents.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1-100 (default 25). Not every endpoint honours it; keep paging until a page is empty.

tools.name: placetel_list_call_center_calls
tools.title: List call center calls
tools.description: Call-center calls of one day with queue, agent, from/to, answer status, start/end time and time spent in queue. date is required; narrow to queues with queue_ids. GET /call_center_calls.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1-100 (default 25). Not every endpoint honours it; keep paging until a page is empty.

tools.name: placetel_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a contact in the shared Placetel phone book. Give at least a name, company or number. Nothing is sent to the contact. POST /contacts.

tags.description: Tags (replaces the existing tags on update; [] clears them).

blocked.description: true = calls from this contact are blocked.

tools.name: placetel_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: WRITE: update the given fields of a contact (omitted fields stay; an empty string clears a text field). tags replaces the whole tag list; blocked=true blocks the caller. PUT /contacts/{id}.

tags.description: Tags (replaces the existing tags on update; [] clears them).

blocked.description: true = calls from this contact are blocked.

tools.name: placetel_activate_number_profile
tools.title: Activate number profile
tools.description: WRITE: switch the active routing profile of a phone number (for example to Holiday or Night). This changes LIVE call handling for that number immediately: callers are routed differently. Find ids with placetel_list_number_profiles. PUT /numbers/{number_id}/profiles.

profile_id.description: Id of the profile to activate.

tools.name: placetel_initiate_call
tools.title: Initiate call
tools.description: WRITE: start a real phone call. Placetel rings the given SIP user's phone first and, once answered, dials the target number. This places an actual call and call charges apply. Do not use without the user's explicit request. POST /calls.

sipuid.description: SIP user that is rung first, e.g. 7771234567@fpbx.de (the sipuid from placetel_list_sip_users).

tools.name: placetel_send_sms
tools.title: Send SMS
tools.description: WRITE: send a real SMS to a phone number from the Placetel account. The recipient receives it immediately and SMS charges apply; it cannot be recalled. Do not use without the user's explicit request and exact text. POST /sms.
